meta.name: skill-builder
meta.description: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档、代码、视频等来源自动构建AI技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从各种来源快速生成AI技能
copy.tagline_en: Auto-build AI skills from documentation, repos, videos, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly generate AI skills from diverse knowledge sources

howto.what: 自动识别你提供的来源类型,如文档链接、GitHub 仓库、PDF、视频或本地代码,抓取内容后整理成可供 AI 使用的技能,并支持打包、增强和导出到向量数据库。
howto.when: 当你想从文档、GitHub、PDF 等资料创建 AI 技能,或需要同步、导出已有技能时触发。

say.text: 把这份文档网站做成一个 AI 技能
say.note: 它会抓取文档并生成技能。

say.text: 根据这个 GitHub 仓库创建技能
say.note: 会自动检测仓库并开始抓取。

say.text: 把刚抓取的技能导出到 Weaviate
say.note: 会调用导出工具写入向量库。

howto.what_en: Automatically detects the type of knowledge source (doc links, GitHub repos, PDFs, videos, local code, etc.), scrapes its content, then packages it into AI-ready skills, with optional enhancement and vector database export.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to create an AI skill from sources like docs, GitHub, or PDFs, or need to sync or export an existing skill.

say_en.text: Turn this documentation site into an AI skill.
say_en.note: It will scrape the docs and build the skill.

say_en.text: Create a skill from this GitHub repository.
say_en.note: It detects the repo and starts scraping.

say_en.text: Export the skill to a vector database.
say_en.note: It calls the vector DB export tool.
